tooltips.astral_craft.platform_candy_gho: Use Star Coins to get random candy.
tooltips.astral_craft.platform_destiny: Trigger the random event for yourself.
tooltips.astral_craft.platform_divine: Player chooses the effect. Randomly chooses the target.
tooltips.astral_craft.platform_event: Randomly trigger the event for all players.
tooltips.astral_craft.platform_fire: Select a player, deal 2 direct damages.
tooltips.astral_craft.platform_gamble: After making bets on the parity of the roll, the victor receives all bets.
tooltips.astral_craft.platform_gift: Get or return a gift when staying on this panel.
tooltips.astral_craft.platform_hospital: Heal 2 HP and stay in hospital. Immune to all damage when stay on this panel.
tooltips.astral_craft.platform_jump: Teleport to the corresponding Jump panel.
tooltips.astral_craft.platform_lottery: Choose a number from 1-12. Clear the number after the draw.
tooltips.astral_craft.platform_relic: Can buy chips on this panel.
tooltips.astral_craft.platform_shop: Buy cards when stay on or pass by this panel.
tooltips.astral_craft.platform_start: Heal 2 HP when staying on Start Point. Gain 1 star with enough coins.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_all_or_no:
ATK +5. During the next battle, your opponent cannot evade.
If you don't KO your opponent, you will suffer STUN.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_ashen_fea:
Cannot be used. At the start of your turn, gain 1 stack of §9【Warm Flame】§r.
This card transforms into Colourful Feather after removing 4 stacks of §9【Warm Flame】.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_barricade: Set a barricade within 10 panels. Players will stop on the barricade panel.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_barrier: Nullify the effect card targeting on you.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_berserk: Apply to a target player within 10 panels. ATK +3, Damage Taken +1. Lasts 2 Turns.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_bite: Gain 1 stack of §9【Awakening】§r; this turn, increase ATK by up to 4 based on §9【Awakening】§r stacks. This attack cannot be countered.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_blast: Select a monster within 6 panels, deal 4 damage to the target and all monsters within 2 panels of it.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_both_have: Choose an ally. You and that ally each receive a card.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_brick: Deal 5 damage to an opponent within 3 panels.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_charge: ATK +5, add a Powerful Attack to your hand.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_colourful: Teleport to a panel up to 5 panels away, then recover 3 HP.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_demolitio: Use the card within 3 panels. Deal 3 damages to the player activating the panel.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_energy_ba: Select one character to gain +3 ATK and +2 MOV for 2 turns, afterward apply 2 stacks of §9【Overclock】.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_enhanced_: Set on a panel up to 10 panels away. Players will stop their movement on this panel, and gains +2 Move on their next turn.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_entrapmen: Set a trap within 3 panels, and get 5 coins from the player activating the trap.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_fight_fir: Take 2 damages. Then heal 3 HP each turn. Lasts 2 turns.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_firecrack: Target a Monster within 10 panels, deal 3 damage, remove all §9【Enlivener】【LionGawu】§r, and prevent counterattacks this round.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_fortune: Gain +1 card play count this turn; Choose an ally to restore 2 HP.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_hurry: Choose an ally. When the ally move, roll 2 dice once.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_king_powe: HP-4, gain +5 ATK, lasting for 3 turns.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_laser: Deal 3 damage to an opponent within 6 panels.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_living_bo: Deal 2 damage to a target monster within 5 panels and apply 1 stack of §9【Mark】§r.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_luxurious: Choose an ally. All characters within 3 panels of that ally recover 3 HP.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_misfortun: Target an enemy within 10 panels, deal 1 damage; if this card remains in your hand at the end of the turn, take 1 damage.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_overflowi: Gain +8 Card Play this turn. Gain 888 Star Coins and 88 stacks of Starlight. Permanently gain +8 ATK. All players restore 88 HP.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_poison_fa: Remove 2 stacks of §9【Golden Scales】§r from target, then target cannot counterattack.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_powerful_: ATK +6, Final ATK +50% for this battle.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_problem_s:
Choose another character, deal 2 damage to them and apply §9【Problem Students】§r. Then, gain 3 Star Coins.
At the end of your turn, if this card is still in your hand, take 2 damage.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_quirky_en: Choose: Release Azure Soul; Release Scarlet Soul
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_railgun: Deal 6 damages to a monster within 5 panels.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_random_po: Use to be teleported to a random PORTAL panel.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_random_se: Reflect the effect card targeting on you to another opponent.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_release_a: Choose a monster to attack yourself, then counterattack that monster. During this combat, monster ATK -3, DEF -3.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_release_s: Take 1 damage, then target a monster up to 6 panels away and deal 3 damage to it. Remove your §9【Azure Curse】§r and §9【Scarlet Venom】§r; for each stack removed, deal an additional instance of damage.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_scavengin: Collect the coins dropped within 3 panels.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_self_expl: Take 3 damages. Deal 5 damages to opponents within 5 panels.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_shadow_at: ATK +3. Immune to counterattack. (Only for attacker)
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_slingshot: Deal 2 damages to an opponent within 10 panels.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_smart_dic: Next movement points can be chosen freely between 1-6.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_smartie_g: Select one character to draw 3 cards and remove their §9【Overclock】§r.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_snatch: Gain 5 coins from a target player.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_snowball_: Target a character within 9 panels, deal 1 damage and -4 movement for the next turn.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_soul_link: Link 2 target players. When a player takes damage the other takes equal damage. Lasts 3 turns.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_support: Select one character, teleport to their current panel.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_support_g: Select one character to restore 2 HP and remove their §9【Overclock】§r, gain +1 card play this turn.
tooltips.astral_craft.handcard_time_bomb:
Place a bomb for the next player.
At the start of the round, when the roll is 1: Receive 99 damage. 2-6: Pass it to the next player.
